title: The documented journey completes from an empty directory on both platforms
statement: From a temporary empty directory the documented sequence — including `git init` into a repository with no commits, before any commit exists — initialises, installs, registers, binds a deterministic non-billable model, starts both processes with identity-confirmed readiness, and reaches a Stage 1 question. Verified on Windows and the supported POSIX CI platform.
notes: PASS 2026-09-24 on EVD-0145, on the journey control, which passed in all four cells of CI run 36065687783. That run was RED OVERALL: Windows Node 24 failed an unrelated shutdown platform-evidence test (F130). The documented sequence ran as the README states it, from an empty repository with no commit. Setup's questions were answered by flags and the model was a non-billable loopback fixture. The run reached a Stage 1 question with identity-confirmed readiness. The first turn was piped /kiln-start test input; an interactive session is observed by ACC-0103 and ACC-0088.
